requiredFindings.title: Price member reach names in UTF-8 bytes rather than Unicode scalars
requiredFindings.description: repository(member=True) adds only LOGICAL_PATH_MAX=4096 bytes for all member-directory names. LogicalPath limits Unicode scalars, while open_child_directory_cost charges name.as_bytes().len(). For example, 255 segments of 15 U+10000 scalars followed by one segment of 16 U+10000 scalars form a valid 4096-scalar, 256-segment LogicalPath: each component is at most 64 UTF-8 bytes, but the opened names total 15364 bytes, exceeding the 4096-byte allowance by 11268 bytes. This assumption is inherited from r4 and remains in r5's reissued complete derivation. The canonical record correction is sound; this finding concerns the separate member-reach component.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Separate the 4096-scalar bound used by the escaped-payload formula from a proven UTF-8 byte bound used by member reach, update the plan/evidence/output totals and residual margin, and add a multibyte member-reach pricing control to C1b-1. A conservative 4*4096-byte reach allowance adds 786432 bytes across 64 members and still fits the current caps at the published coordinates. Recheck the search and boundary outputs; do not change the canonical-record maximum or introduce a narrower product path restriction.
